main_body: A tall brown barrel/crate stack on the right with a white sack at its lower right, plus a smaller banded barrel on the left. All are drawn face-on.
top_band: Column x=15: row 0 dark outline, then rows 1-2 (2 rows) of lighter brown #885a26 (L=98), then the body at L=69-74. That is only a 1-2px rim; no real top surface is visible.
evidence: The scan shows only a 2-row lighter rim at the top (rows 1-2) over a tall flat front face. This is the guide's red 'rim only' and 'barrel: lid 2px' case, not an ellipse top. The horizontal bands (rows 9-10, 14) are vertical straps on the face. The left barrel has the same thin top. There is no front-edge line, no eave shadow, no inset front and no visible opening, so the main body fails the 3/4 contract.

style.evidence: The candidate carries a median of 18 colours per tile against 17 and 20 for the references. Flat-fill coverage is 12%, close to the cheese stall's 13%. Only 8% of dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outlines are tinted brown, in the dark tone of the adjacent wood. Wood grain, straps and the sack give about 5 shading steps. Total distinct colours (24) are lower than the references (38-40), but that is expected for a small piece. It would sit acceptably beside the references.
